flagged.evidence: The title says “The posterior mean need not be a small-ball MAP.” Verification 3.1 proves that 2/3 is a strong small-ball MAP, and 4.1 computes the posterior mean as 3/5. Those facts show a MAP differs from the mean, but do not show that 3/5 itself fails the definition’s ratio-to-global-supremum condition; no such ratio is computed. Thus the title’s non-membership claim is stronger than the verification establishes.
